verdict.rationale: Airbyte offers multiple building blocks for headless, agent-driven pipeline creation—the Airbyte API for programmatic control (also usable from orchestrators like Airflow), PyAirbyte for Python/AI developers, a Terraform provider for config-as-code, and abctl as a CLI to stand up Airbyte via Docker—plus documented MCP servers for agent connectivity. However, no single documented workflow shows a coding agent using one unified CLI/API to scaffold+configure+run a full pipeline end-to-end; it requires stitching together several different tools (Terraform, API, PyAirbyte, abctl), and there's no independent/hands-on validation of this headless flow. missing for 10: a first-party or independent end-to-end example of an agent scaffolding, configuring, and running a pipeline purely through one CLI/API without manual UI steps; hands-on/community corroboration of this specific workflow.
